header.text: The Physics of Relations · Chapter 1. The Cavity Resonator Earth

cues.inhalt: The Cavity Resonator Earth

cues.inhalt: An abstract terminal spectrum: irregular thin lines across the frame, random heights, pure bandwidth, no pattern.

cues.inhalt: Two small wave diagrams side by side: destructive interference canceling to a flat line, constructive interference reinforcing to a high amplitude.

cues.inhalt: Left: a small, irregular tangle of lines with no shape. Right: the familiar core-mantle cross-section, clearly defined.
